feat(marketing): unify films and images into one marketing workspace (#513)

* feat(marketing): unify films and images into one marketing workspace

Merge apps/marketing/launch-video and apps/marketing/cover into a single
`marketing` package. The studio becomes a workspace with an overview plus
per-project Renders and Preview tabs for both videos and images.

- Images are projects in images/<id>/ (image.js outputs + index.html page);
  cover is the first one.
- `pnpm marketing render <id>` renders a film to MP4 or an image to one PNG
  per output, with sidecars and optional publish targets.
- `/@deck/<deck>/<page>.png` screenshots real decks for any page, cached
  by deck sources.
- New scripts: `pnpm dev:marketing`, `new:film`, `new:image`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(marketing): add create-image skill alongside create-video

Rename the launch-video skill to create-video and add create-image, which
walks an agent from a subject to a rendered, multi-size marketing image.
Image renders now fail fast and name any image that didn't load instead of
waiting out the timeout.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

chore: move marketing workspace out of the monorepo (#521)

The films and images workspace (apps/marketing) and its create-video /
create-image skills now live in a separate open-slide-marketing repo.
Drop the app, its root scripts, lockfile importer, and AGENTS.md entry.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(core): bring undo/redo back to the edited page and select it (#522)

Undo and redo now navigate to the page an edit was made on and select
the changed element once that page is on screen. The reveal only resolves
inside the current page layer, so undoing mid-transition doesn't land on
the outgoing page.

Also stops cross-page text undo from replaying one instance's HTML onto a
reused component on the visible page, and shows keyboard shortcuts on the
undo/redo buttons.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
fix: treat slide ids as taken when only the case differs (#539)

fix(core): prevent slide toolbar overlap in narrow windows (#544)

* fix(core): keep slide toolbar usable in narrow windows

* test(core): move toolbar test cleanup to afterEach

Closing the page in the test body's finally block ran before Playwright's
only-on-failure capture, dropping the failure screenshot. Cleanup now runs
in afterEach, after the capture, and still closes the page before deleting
the slide so the dev server does not try to hot-reload a removed module.

feat(core): add a chrome-less page preview route for agents (#546)

* feat(core): add a chrome-less page preview route for agents

Adds a dev-only `/s/<id>/preview?p=N[&step=N]` route that renders a single
page at native size with a `data-osd-preview` ready/error signal, writes the
dev server URL to `node_modules/.open-slide/server.json`, and teaches the
built-in skills to screenshot pages through it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01MQUqAryXeTArAdS6SHShUY

* fix(core): harden preview readiness and server.json cleanup

- Report `error` instead of `ready` when a data-waitfor target or an
  animation hasn't settled by the deadline, or when the page throws while
  rendering (new error boundary).
- Decode images after data-waitfor targets resolve, and re-settle when the
  `step` param changes.
- Await the pending server.json write before cleanup and only remove the
  file this server published.
- Skill: describe the error cases and use `npx --no playwright`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01MQUqAryXeTArAdS6SHShUY

* fix(core): bound font and image waits in the preview route

- Race document.fonts.ready and image decoding against the settle
  deadline and report `error` naming what timed out.
- Give each server.json publication its own temp file and clean it up
  if publishing fails.
